paragraphs.text: Cipriano Pantoja Esquivel was arrested in Arrest MTY-10-02 on 2010-10-08. Círculo del Valle Quieto was linked to Arrest MTY-10-02 on 2010-10-08. Arrest MTY-10-02 occurred at Monterrey on 2010-10-08. Liaison reporting from a contact in the capital described the arrest of Pantoja, a sicario chief for Círculo del Valle Quieto whom his crew called El Candado, at a checkpoint on the highway into Monterrey. The contact stated that Pantoja was carrying weapons and a list of vehicle plates and that the arrest followed the earlier detention of another enforcer from the same network by a few weeks.

Aurelio Castañón Vidaurri led Círculo del Valle Quieto from 2010-09-01 until 2019-05-23. The contact characterized Castañón as the head of the network and stated that the loss of two enforcers in the first weeks had caused him to replace the enforcement structure with men drawn from his trucking firm's security staff. The contact assessed that the network's trucking operations were not affected by either arrest. The contact added that the replacement enforcers were former private security guards with no criminal records, which the contact assessed as a deliberate choice to lower the network's profile with the state police.

The reporting office assesses the liaison contact as reliable on arrests reported through official channels but notes that the contact's information on the network's internal response is secondhand. The source reporting was received through the standard liaison channel for this agency. A consumer with a related investigation should contact the originating office before dissemination. The reporting office will forward the vehicle plate list if it is made available through the liaison channel.
